outcome.Summary: Added tags and due dates to tasker, keeping the model/store/query/cli layering: model.Task gained `Tags []string` (omitempty) and `Due *time.Time` (omitempty, normalised to UTC) with tag normalisation (trim/lower/dedupe/sort) in Validate and new `model.ErrBadTag` for tags failing `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`; store.Version bumped to 2 (v1 files still load, saves always write 2); `add` accepts repeatable `--tag` and `--due YYYY-MM-DD`; `edit` accepts `--tag`, `--untag` (absent ok) and `--due`/`--due none`; `list` gained `--tag` (ALL match), `--overdue` (open tasks due strictly before today's UTC date) and `--sort due` (no-due last, ties by ID), all combinable with `--all`/`--sort id|priority`; `FormatTask` appends ` (due ...)` and ` [tags]`; new `tags` command prints open-task tag counts sorted; usage message and README updated. Added tests at every layer (model normalisation/ErrBadTag, store v1→v2 migration, query tag/overdue/due-sort, CLI end-to-end incl. exit codes) plus an end-to-end smoke test of the built binary; `go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1` passes with all pre-existing tests intact.
